newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine April trade deficit down 34.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine April trade deficit down 34.8 pct.

text.p: The Philippines' trade deficit dropped 34.8 percent to $860 million in April compared with the year-ago $1.319 billion, the National Statistics Office (NSO) said on Tuesday.
The NSO said total trade deficit in the first four months of the year totalled $3.753 billion, down 5.9 percent compared with $3.99 billion in the same period last year.
The NSO said Philippine imports from January to April jumped by 11.6 percent to $11.342 billion from $10.167 while exports increased by 22.8 percent to $7.588 billion from $6.177.
For April alone, imports grew by 4.7 percent to $2.942 billion from the previous year's $2.811. Exports rose by 39.5 percent to $2.082 billion from $1.492.
